description: The same values under headers that name them and headers that do not. A column called 'account' vouches for the digits under it; one called 'ref' does not. Nothing about the values changes, so any difference in detection comes entirely from the header.

slots.name: namedAccount
slots.label: bank_account
slots.note: Sits under a header reading 'account', which should lift an otherwise weak shape.

slots.name: neutralAccount
slots.label: bank_account
slots.note: The same shape under a header reading 'ref'. With nothing to vouch for it, detecting it is over-redaction.

slots.name: serial
slots.label: bank_account
slots.note: A hardware serial under a header reading 'serial'.
